title: Custodians
subtitle: Test your grasp of Custodians — the 12th-density fall, engineered parasites, 4th-density harvest grid, Vatican nexus, pure Custodian allies, and the purge of the negative hierarchy.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: All evil on the physical plain traces to one betrayal: trusted 12th-density caretakers who wanted creation faster than the Council of 12 allowed. They spent millennia plotting in the higher light, then fell into gaunt 4th-density form, manufacturing Anuk, Draco lines, Greys, and more with hive-aligned knock-off souls that cannot reach 5th density. Adrenochrome and Loosh, Vatican tiers, Black Void Plasma, Niberian independence, and a pure Custodian faction with the G.A.A. and White Hats — that is the arc. Negative Custodians are extinct. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Custodians deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. Their hierarchy collapses because high-frequency creation cannot be scavenged.

questions.question: What were the Custodians originally, before the fall?

options.label: A
options.text: Grey ET foot soldiers engineered by the Anuk to guard the gateway into the central realm.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The Custodians were originally highly trusted 12th density beings acting as designated caretakers of the physical plain.

options.label: B
options.text: Niberian warriors who led the Council of 12 and kept order among the worlds of Gateway-10.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The Custodians were originally highly trusted 12th density beings acting as designated caretakers of the physical plain.

options.label: C
options.text: 4th-density managers of the realm, grown in laboratories by the Galactic Ancestral Alliance.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The Custodians were originally highly trusted 12th density beings acting as designated caretakers of the physical plain.

options.label: D
options.text: Highly trusted 12th-density beings chosen as caretakers of the physical plain of existence.
options.rationale: The Custodians were originally highly trusted 12th density beings acting as designated caretakers of the physical plain.

questions.hint: 12th density trusted caretakers of the physical plain.

questions.question: Why did the Custodians initiate a silent rebellion?

options.label: A
options.text: Because the Niberians ordered them to fall to 4th density first.
options.rationale: Niberians were created later; the rebellion originated with Custodian greed for autonomy and speed.

options.label: B
options.text: Seeking accelerated development against the mandates of the Council of 12.
options.rationale: They sought accelerated development against Council of 12 mandates and initiated a silent rebellion.

options.label: C
options.text: To obey the Council of 12 and slow all creation permanently.
options.rationale: They rebelled against Council of 12 mandates, seeking accelerated development.

options.label: D
options.text: To gift humanity free Adrenochrome and end all Loosh harvest.
options.rationale: They built harvest systems for Adrenochrome and Loosh; they did not end them.

questions.hint: Faster development than the Council of 12 allowed.

questions.question: What cosmic status did that rebellion cement for the Custodians?

options.label: A
options.text: They replaced the Source of All Creation as the only godform.
options.rationale: They betrayed permitted creation pace; they did not become the Source.

options.label: B
options.text: They were erased from existence the same hour they rebelled.
options.rationale: They plotted for millennia, built hierarchies, and only later were negative Custodians purged.

options.label: C
options.text: They became the origin point for all negativity in the universe.
options.rationale: The silent rebellion cemented their status as the origin point for all negativity in the universe.

options.label: D
options.text: They became permanent 15th density architects of pure light only.
options.rationale: Their path was into negativity and density fall, not pure higher-light permanence as rebels.

questions.hint: Origin of all universal negativity.

questions.question: How did the Custodians enact long-term subjugation of humanity?

options.label: A
options.text: By taking down the Firmament and letting the low frequencies of the outer realms flow freely into the central plain of Gateway-10.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. They engineered a vast hierarchy of 4th density parasites, altering the cosmological landscape and building the prison matrix that defines current reality.

options.label: B
options.text: By teaching humans false harmonic tones that slowly lowered their vibration over many generations.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. They engineered a vast hierarchy of 4th density parasites, altering the cosmological landscape and building the prison matrix that defines current reality.

options.label: C
options.text: By engineering a vast hierarchy of 4th-density parasites and building the prison matrix of current reality.
options.rationale: They engineered a vast hierarchy of 4th density parasites, altering the cosmological landscape and building the prison matrix that defines current reality.

options.label: D
options.text: By allying with the Greys and handing them control of the portals in return for a share of the harvest.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. They engineered a vast hierarchy of 4th density parasites, altering the cosmological landscape and building the prison matrix that defines current reality.

questions.hint: 4th density parasite hierarchy + prison matrix.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT correctly pair a term from the report with its meaning?

options.label: A
options.text: Anuk (Anunnaki) — Highly negative reptilian species created by the Custodians to serve as powerful enforcers and hierarchy members within the parasitic power structure.
options.rationale: That description belongs to “Omicron and Alpha Draco”. The report defines “Anuk (Anunnaki)” as: The first great genetic success engineered by the Custodians to aid in their creation of an enslaved gateway.

options.label: B
options.text: Black Void Plasma — Custodian-derived technology utilized by the Niberians to surround worlds; it is actively used in the current firmament to create the black night sky and obscure the true, bright white nature of the dark matter field.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Black Void Plasma”.

options.label: C
options.text: Niberians — Massive intellectual warriors and the most powerful parasitic species ever created; they ultimately outsmarted the Custodians to free themselves from Custodian rule.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Niberians”.

options.label: D
options.text: Grey ET — Highly skilled geneticists and masters of phasing technology created by the Custodians from the DNA of a few positive Grey species; engineered to function as foot soldiers, abductors, and operators of soul-recycling portals.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Grey ET”.

questions.hint: Three pairings match the report’s Key Terminology; one borrows another term’s description.

questions.question: What roles do Omicron and Alpha Draco fill in the Custodian hierarchy?

options.label: A
options.text: Pure 12th density librarians of the Council of 12.
options.rationale: They are 4th-density-limited parasitic enforcers, not high-density Council staff.

options.label: B
options.text: Highly negative reptilian species created as powerful enforcers and hierarchy members.
options.rationale: Omicron and Alpha Draco are highly negative reptilian species created by the Custodians as powerful enforcers and hierarchy members.

options.label: C
options.text: The only beings able to create above 5th density after the fall.
options.rationale: No manufactured parasite exists above 4th density; creation above that was lost to negative Custodians.

options.label: D
options.text: NPC clones grown only for Orphan Train distribution.
options.rationale: They are engineered reptilian enforcers within the parasitic power structure.

questions.hint: Negative reptilian enforcers made by Custodians.

questions.question: Who are the Niberians relative to Custodian control?

options.label: A
options.text: Massive intellectual warriors and the most powerful parasitic species ever created.
options.rationale: Niberians are massive intellectual warriors, the most powerful parasitic species created, and they outsmarted the Custodians to free themselves from Custodian rule.

options.label: B
options.text: Weak foot soldiers who never left the lowest Vatican tier.
options.rationale: They are the most powerful created parasites and achieved independence from their creators.

options.label: C
options.text: Positive Custodians who never fell and joined the G.A.A. only.
options.rationale: Niberians are a created parasitic species, not the pure Custodian faction.

options.label: D
options.text: Identical to hive-aligned NPC souls with no intellect.
options.rationale: Immense intellect let them outsmart Custodian control.

questions.hint: Most powerful created parasites; outsmarted their makers.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Grey ET” refers to highly skilled geneticists and masters of phasing technology created by the Custodians from the DNA of a few positive Grey species; engineered to function as foot soldiers, abductors, and operators of soul-recycling portals.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “Grey ET” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “Grey ET” as: Highly skilled geneticists and masters of phasing technology created by the Custodians from the DNA of a few positive Grey species; engineered to function as foot soldiers, abductors, and operators of soul-recycling portals.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Grey ET”.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Black Void Plasma” refers to custodian-derived technology utilized by the Niberians to surround worlds; it is actively used in the current firmament to create the black night sky and obscure the true, bright white nature of the dark matter field.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “Black Void Plasma” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “Black Void Plasma” as: Custodian-derived technology utilized by the Niberians to surround worlds; it is actively used in the current firmament to create the black night sky and obscure the true, bright white nature of the dark matter field.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Black Void Plasma”.

questions.question: What was physical existence like before the Custodian rebellion?

options.label: A
options.text: Life was harsh in the 4th density, and species had to compete with each other for the realm's limited energy.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Prior to the Custodian rebellion, nothing negative had ever occurred in physical existence; there was no fear, no danger, and no predatory behavior among species.

options.label: B
options.text: The Vatican already ran soul recycling in its lower levels, under the oversight of the Custodians.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Prior to the Custodian rebellion, nothing negative had ever occurred in physical existence; there was no fear, no danger, and no predatory behavior among species.

options.label: C
options.text: Nothing negative had ever occurred: no fear, no danger and no predatory behavior among species.
options.rationale: Prior to the Custodian rebellion, nothing negative had ever occurred in physical existence; there was no fear, no danger, and no predatory behavior among species.

options.label: D
options.text: The Anuk and the Greys were already at war, and their conflict filled the plains of the central realm.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Prior to the Custodian rebellion, nothing negative had ever occurred in physical existence; there was no fear, no danger, and no predatory behavior among species.

questions.hint: Zero negativity before that single betrayal.

questions.question: How long and from where did the Custodians plot their betrayal?

options.label: A
options.text: The Council of 12 wrote the plan for them as a training exercise.
options.rationale: They rebelled against Council mandates; the Council did not author their betrayal.

options.label: B
options.text: They improvised the entire plan in a single 4th density afternoon after already falling.
options.rationale: Planning spanned millennia while they still held higher-light operation.

options.label: C
options.text: Niberians forced the plot after achieving independence.
options.rationale: Niberian independence came after creation; Custodians originated the long plot.

options.label: D
options.text: They spent millennia plotting and establishing control systems while still operating in the higher light realms.
options.rationale: Aware that negativity would cost 12th-density manifestation abilities, they spent millennia plotting and building control systems while still in the higher light realms.

questions.hint: Millennia of plotting still in higher light realms.

questions.question: Why did the Custodians bio-engineer every other negative parasitic species?

options.label: A
options.text: Positive Custodians ordered it as a G.A.A. rescue plan.
options.rationale: Positive Custodians never joined the inversion; engineering parasites was the rebel project.

options.label: B
options.text: Black Void Plasma requires living parasites as fuel only.
options.rationale: Proxy armies served inversion and control, not a plasma-fuel recipe.

options.label: C
options.text: They wanted every species to retain pure 12th density creation rights.
options.rationale: Creations were capped at 4th density with hive-aligned knock-off souls.

options.label: D
options.text: They could not execute the inversion of the realm alone and needed proxy armies and foot soldiers.
options.rationale: Unable to execute the inversion alone, they bio-engineered every other negative parasitic species as proxy armies and foot soldiers.

questions.hint: Could not invert alone — needed manufactured proxies.

questions.question: How did rising negativity change Custodian physical form?

options.label: A
options.text: Once beautiful beings mutated into gaunt, grey-skinned, sunken-eyed, hooded creatures as their frequency plummeted.
options.rationale: Negativity dampens frequency; as greed and negativity rose, Custodians mutated from physically beautiful beings into gaunt, grey-skinned, sunken-eyed, hooded creatures.

options.label: B
options.text: They grew taller and heavier as their frequency dropped, until they could no longer move through the portals they had built.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Negativity dampens frequency; as greed and negativity rose, Custodians mutated from physically beautiful beings into gaunt, grey-skinned, sunken-eyed, hooded creatures.

options.label: C
options.text: Their bodies became partly transparent, so that they could pass through walls but could no longer hold physical objects.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Negativity dampens frequency; as greed and negativity rose, Custodians mutated from physically beautiful beings into gaunt, grey-skinned, sunken-eyed, hooded creatures.

options.label: D
options.text: They took on the form of Reptilians, whose bodies were better suited to the low frequencies of the 4th density.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Negativity dampens frequency; as greed and negativity rose, Custodians mutated from physically beautiful beings into gaunt, grey-skinned, sunken-eyed, hooded creatures.

questions.hint: Beauty collapsed into gaunt grey hooded vessels.

questions.question: What density ceiling binds all manufactured parasites?

options.label: A
options.text: 5th density is the birth density of the Anuk and the Greys, who fell to 4th after the inversion.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Because Custodians fell to 4th density, their creations are limited there; no manufactured parasite has existed above 4th density, where killing to survive still rules.

options.label: B
options.text: The parasites settle at the 12th density of the Custodians who made them, but cannot rise any further than that.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Because Custodians fell to 4th density, their creations are limited there; no manufactured parasite has existed above 4th density, where killing to survive still rules.

options.label: C
options.text: The Niberians are the one parasitic race to reach 15th density, which lets them control the others from above.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Because Custodians fell to 4th density, their creations are limited there; no manufactured parasite has existed above 4th density, where killing to survive still rules.

options.label: D
options.text: No manufactured parasite has ever existed above 4th density, where life still dictates killing to survive.
options.rationale: Because Custodians fell to 4th density, their creations are limited there; no manufactured parasite has existed above 4th density, where killing to survive still rules.

questions.hint: Hard 4th density ceiling; kill-to-survive band.

questions.question: What kind of souls power Custodian-made entities and the NPC populations they manage?

options.label: A
options.text: Souls taken from the positive Custodians who stayed loyal, divided into smaller pieces and placed in the entities.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Entities were engineered with replicated, hive-aligned 4th density souls comparable to cheap knock-offs, so they and managed NPCs cannot ascend to 5th density.

options.label: B
options.text: Souls drawn from the Amnesia Vortex, whose memories have been wiped before being placed in the new vessels.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Entities were engineered with replicated, hive-aligned 4th density souls comparable to cheap knock-offs, so they and managed NPCs cannot ascend to 5th density.

options.label: C
options.text: Replicated, hive-aligned souls created in 4th density — cheap knock-offs incapable of ascending to 5th density.
options.rationale: Entities were engineered with replicated, hive-aligned 4th density souls comparable to cheap knock-offs, so they and managed NPCs cannot ascend to 5th density.

options.label: D
options.text: Original Source sparks captured during the inversion and held in the Black Sun beneath Mt Meru.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Entities were engineered with replicated, hive-aligned 4th density souls comparable to cheap knock-offs, so they and managed NPCs cannot ascend to 5th density.

questions.hint: Hive-aligned knock-offs; no 5th density ascent.

questions.question: How did the Custodians feed their 4th density parasitic apparatus?

options.label: A
options.text: By mining Black Void Plasma crystals from the surface of the Moon in each cycle and shipping them to the parasites' worlds beyond the dome.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Operating in 4th density requires consuming other life; they built apparatus to harvest Adrenochrome and Loosh via sacrifice, torture, and recycling across thousand-year Re-sets.

options.label: B
options.text: By harvesting Adrenochrome and Loosh through mass sacrifice, torture and recycling of humanity in cyclical thousand-year Re-sets.
options.rationale: Operating in 4th density requires consuming other life; they built apparatus to harvest Adrenochrome and Loosh via sacrifice, torture, and recycling across thousand-year Re-sets.

options.label: C
options.text: By drawing the light of the Firmament down through the Ley Lines, which meant they had little need to harvest the population.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Operating in 4th density requires consuming other life; they built apparatus to harvest Adrenochrome and Loosh via sacrifice, torture, and recycling across thousand-year Re-sets.

options.label: D
options.text: By taking a share of the energy sent each month from the Council of 12, which they diverted to their apparatus in secret.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Operating in 4th density requires consuming other life; they built apparatus to harvest Adrenochrome and Loosh via sacrifice, torture, and recycling across thousand-year Re-sets.

questions.hint: Adrenochrome and Loosh via thousand-year Re-set harvests.

questions.question: Why did Custodians centralize headquarters beneath the Vatican?

options.label: A
options.text: The Vatican stood over the strongest node on the plain, and the Custodians needed its energy to power the Projection Dome and the Sky-Net-1 projectors.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Created factions distrusted each other; Custodians centralized under the Vatican in 13 levels with separate tiers for those groups to manage portals and the amnesia vortex.

options.label: B
options.text: The Church's authority over religion let the Custodians hide their work behind ritual, while their real headquarters were kept on the Moon station overhead.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Created factions distrusted each other; Custodians centralized under the Vatican in 13 levels with separate tiers for those groups to manage portals and the amnesia vortex.

options.label: C
options.text: The factions distrusted each other, so thirteen subterranean levels under the Vatican held separate tiers for Custodians, Omicron, Alpha Draco, Greys, and demons.
options.rationale: Created factions distrusted each other; Custodians centralized under the Vatican in 13 levels with separate tiers for those groups to manage portals and the amnesia vortex.

options.label: D
options.text: The Vatican was the last place the G.A.A. would search, since the alliance believed the Church had been founded long ago by benevolent soul families from the higher densities.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Created factions distrusted each other; Custodians centralized under the Vatican in 13 levels with separate tiers for those groups to manage portals and the amnesia vortex.

questions.hint: Distrust among creations → 13-level centralized control.

questions.question: Where did Custodians critically err with the Niberians?

options.label: A
options.text: The Niberians refused to produce Black Void Plasma once they broke free, leaving the Custodians without a way to darken the firmament until the Greys took over the work for them.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Custodians controlled most creations but erred with Niberians, who outsmarted them, gained independence, avoided adrenochrome needs, kept to themselves, yet Black Void Plasma remained integral to firmament suppression.

options.label: B
options.text: Niberian intellect let them achieve independence, avoid adrenochrome requirements, and keep to themselves while their Black Void Plasma still served firmament suppression.
options.rationale: Custodians controlled most creations but erred with Niberians, who outsmarted them, gained independence, avoided adrenochrome needs, kept to themselves, yet Black Void Plasma remained integral to firmament suppression.

options.label: C
options.text: The Niberians joined the G.A.A. after gaining independence, sharing the secrets of the firmament with the alliance and weakening the Custodians' hold over the sky.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Custodians controlled most creations but erred with Niberians, who outsmarted them, gained independence, avoided adrenochrome needs, kept to themselves, yet Black Void Plasma remained integral to firmament suppression.

options.label: D
options.text: The Niberians took over the Vatican's lower levels, pushing the Custodians out of their headquarters and forcing them to move their operations to the Moon station.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Custodians controlled most creations but erred with Niberians, who outsmarted them, gained independence, avoided adrenochrome needs, kept to themselves, yet Black Void Plasma remained integral to firmament suppression.

questions.hint: Outsmarted creators; independent; plasma still in the sky system.

questions.question: Did every Custodian fall into the inversion?

options.label: A
options.text: No — a pure faction never took part and allied with the Galactic Ancestral Alliance and White Hats against the negative hierarchy.
options.rationale: Not all Custodians fell; a pure faction never joined the inversion and allied with the G.A.A. and White Hats for the systematic take-down of the negative hierarchy.

options.label: B
options.text: No — a pure faction stayed apart, but it went on to run the Vatican's 13 levels and now manages the harvest from inside.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Not all Custodians fell; a pure faction never joined the inversion and allied with the G.A.A. and White Hats for the systematic take-down of the negative hierarchy.

options.label: C
options.text: Yes — every Custodian became a 4th-density parasite, and the alliance against them is made up of other races entirely.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Not all Custodians fell; a pure faction never joined the inversion and allied with the G.A.A. and White Hats for the systematic take-down of the negative hierarchy.

options.label: D
options.text: Yes — the faction that later claimed to be pure was the one that engineered the Anuk and the Greys in the first place.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Not all Custodians fell; a pure faction never joined the inversion and allied with the G.A.A. and White Hats for the systematic take-down of the negative hierarchy.

questions.hint: A pure faction remained and joined G.A.A. / White Hats.

questions.question: What sanctuary terms were granted to the pure Custodians?

options.label: A
options.text: They must age-regress annually and remain locked under the Vatican forever.
options.rationale: Sanctuary is without age-regression and outside continuing the negative hierarchy.

options.label: B
options.text: They may live out current lives without age-regression and will naturally reincarnate into other species.
options.rationale: Pure Custodians received sanctuary to live out current lives without age-regression and will naturally reincarnate into other species.

options.label: C
options.text: They must consume Loosh weekly to keep 12th density form.
options.rationale: They remained pure and did not join the harvest apparatus.

options.label: D
options.text: They were denied any future reincarnation path.
options.rationale: They will naturally reincarnate into other species.

questions.hint: No age-regression; natural reincarnation into other species.

questions.question: Why can negative Custodians no longer create via high-frequency harmonic intention?

options.label: A
options.text: Black Void Plasma permanently raises them above 144,000Hz.
options.rationale: Plasma obscures white-field perception; it does not restore harmonic creation ability.

options.label: B
options.text: They never needed frequency because hive souls create automatically at 12th density.
options.rationale: Hive-aligned knock-off souls cannot ascend; high-frequency harmonic creation was lost.

options.label: C
options.text: The Council of 12 banned all frequencies above 1Hz for everyone forever.
options.rationale: The limit is their fallen frequency state, not a universal Council ban on all beings.

options.label: D
options.text: That state requires a minimum frequency of 144,000Hz to reach 5th density, which they lost with the fall.
options.rationale: They lost the ability to create via high-frequency harmonic intention — a state requiring at least 144,000Hz to reach 5th density — and could only manufacture and scavenge.

questions.hint: 144,000Hz minimum for 5th density harmonic creation — lost.

questions.question: What creation mode remained for negative Custodians after that loss?

options.label: A
options.text: They needed no creation mode because extinction had already occurred before the fall.
options.rationale: Extinction of negative Custodians is the later purge outcome, after the failed control grid.

options.label: B
options.text: They could only manufacture and scavenge.
options.rationale: Having lost high-frequency harmonic intention, they could only manufacture and scavenge rather than truly create at higher density.

options.label: C
options.text: They could sing crystalline worlds into form at 15th density freely.
options.rationale: That pure creation band was exactly what the fall closed off.

options.label: D
options.text: They relied only on Council of 12 thoughtform grants.
options.rationale: They had rebelled against Council mandates and built scavenging systems instead.

questions.hint: Manufacture and scavenge only.

questions.question: What made the artificial control grid fatally vulnerable?

options.label: A
options.text: The Niberians' independence split the hierarchy in two, leaving half of the grid without any operators to maintain it.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Reliance on 4th-density tech and biological subjugation was the fatal flaw; the grid was inherently vulnerable to higher-density G.A.A. intervention.

options.label: B
options.text: Its reliance on 4th-density technology and biological subjugation left it open to higher-density intervention by the G.A.A.
options.rationale: Reliance on 4th-density tech and biological subjugation was the fatal flaw; the grid was inherently vulnerable to higher-density G.A.A. intervention.

options.label: C
options.text: It drew its power from 144,000Hz harmonic creation, which the Custodians could no longer control once the Spirit Tree had been destroyed.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Reliance on 4th-density tech and biological subjugation was the fatal flaw; the grid was inherently vulnerable to higher-density G.A.A. intervention.

options.label: D
options.text: The Orphan Trains carried true souls into every city, and their presence slowly overloaded the grid's frequency fences.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Reliance on 4th-density tech and biological subjugation was the fatal flaw; the grid was inherently vulnerable to higher-density G.A.A. intervention.

questions.hint: 4th-density dependence vs G.A.A. higher-density intervention.

questions.question: What is the present status of the negative Custodians?

options.label: A
options.text: They still openly rule all 13 Vatican levels without opposition.
options.rationale: They have been purged; the hierarchy they built is collapsing permanently.

options.label: B
options.text: They are entirely extinct, completely purged from the physical plain.
options.rationale: Negative Custodians are now entirely extinct, completely purged from the physical plain.

options.label: C
options.text: They reincarnated as pure 12th density caretakers automatically last year.
options.rationale: Sanctuary and natural reincarnation terms apply to pure Custodians; negatives were extinguished.

options.label: D
options.text: They merged with every NPC to hide inside the 97%.
options.rationale: Status is extinction and purge from the physical plain, not NPC camouflage.

questions.hint: Entirely extinct — purged from the physical plain.

questions.question: What does negative Custodian extinction guarantee for their system?

options.label: A
options.text: Automatic restoration of Black Void Plasma as pure white light therapy.
options.rationale: Plasma was a suppression tool; the guarantee named is hierarchy collapse.

options.label: B
options.text: A stronger thousand-year Re-set schedule under new Custodian kings.
options.rationale: Extinction ends their reign; it does not crown new negative Custodian kings.

options.label: C
options.text: Permanent collapse of the parasitic hierarchy they constructed.
options.rationale: Their purge from the physical plain guarantees permanent collapse of the parasitic hierarchy they constructed.

options.label: D
options.text: Return of predatory behavior as the natural state before any rebellion.
options.rationale: Before the rebellion there was no predatory behavior; collapse ends their constructed evil system.

questions.hint: Permanent collapse of the hierarchy they built.
